correctness.rationale: The exact root support function separates one-orientation faces from tied-orientation faces; tied midpoint ranges give three exhaustive patterns. Explicit potentials expose every pattern, affine-span arguments prove each dimension, and disjoint multinomial counting yields the polynomial in every dimension. Eight independently constructed finite face lattices corroborate, but do not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: A rank-complete and face-lattice-complete classification for every pair p,q>=2 fills a natural middle-dimensional enumeration gap for a non-simplicial polytope family. It specifies combinatorial support types and arbitrary rank counts, extending materially beyond known vertex, edge, triangle, facet and Ehrhart facts; no artificial parameter slice is used.
